claim: Two completed projects promote only the common pitched-hydraulic geometry capability; one per-head project cannot satisfy a two-project promotion, and the nine-head/eight-edge subset remains neither whole-building-ready nor compliance-ready.
theorem:
theorem dallasPitchedPortfolioFailClosed :
  let projectCount : Nat := 2
  let commonGeometryCount : Nat := 2
  let perHeadIdentityCount : Nat := 1
  let requiredCount : Nat := 2
  let mappedHeads : Nat := 9
  let mappedPipes : Nat := 8
  let wholeBuildingReady : Bool := false
  let complianceReady : Bool := false
  And (commonGeometryCount >= requiredCount)
    (And (Not (perHeadIdentityCount >= requiredCount))
      (And (mappedPipes + 1 = mappedHeads)
        (And (projectCount = requiredCount)
          (And (wholeBuildingReady = false)
            (complianceReady = false))))) :=
